shows.title: The river: all looks (playlist)
shows.label: the river (playlist)
shows.description: Every look in one show file, played in a configurable order: a playlist of looks, each for so many loops, cycles or minutes, looping; or one look pinned. The remembered river, Fill my cup (simple and configurable), the river's year and Combined with Modal Input Selector, faded through black between them. Each look keeps its own settings; mission control's Looks tab edits the playlist, each look's settings and shows the live inputs.
inputs: Dave's agent (memory, surge hour, palette and knobs in gallery_state)
River\remembered\control.json (pool line, light checks, opening night)
Dave's Modal canvas, mirrored scene, reflexes and frames (Combined with Modal)

remembered.title: The remembered river
remembered.description: Dry Creek relives one remembered day from its past every five minutes: calm drips, a building flow, then the surge, a white front falling down every rope into a churning pool, then settling. Dave's agent picks the day (bitcube picks a notable one when he is late); a new day arrives with one slow wave down the ropes. The screens are windows onto twisting silk ribbons of glitter falling through the room, the river's moving water faint beneath. People standing still slow the light and draw it to their ropes.
inputs: Dave's agent (memory, surge hour, palette and knobs in gallery_state)
River\remembered\control.json (pool line, light checks, opening night)

fill-simple.title: Fill my cup (simple)
fill-simple.description: The first filling-cup look the artists liked best: every rope and screen one canvas, by real height; smooth churning blue and black water rises from the floor to the top with a slosh and a crest, soft spray and drips, holds, then drains all the way out, and again (about 84 s a cycle).
inputs: the LED map, screens and zones (calibration, measured screen heights and tilts)

fill-configurable.title: Fill my cup (configurable)
fill-configurable.description: Every rope and every screen is one canvas, by each LED's real height above the floor. Water rises from the floor to the top like a cup filling, turbulent and sloshing, a crashing white crest, soft spray, bubbles and drips, deep colour broken by churning black; it holds at the top, then drains all the way out, and fills again (about 84 s a cycle). Dials in mission control: palette, brightness, intensity, speed.
inputs: the LED map, screens and zones (calibration, measured screen heights and tilts)

seasons.title: The river's year
seasons.description: Plays the recorded river through a year that only turns forward: still white winter, green spring rain, a golden summer torrent, a rust-and-mud autumn. Automatic mode turns one season a minute; dynamic mode lets the people counter warm it toward summer as the room fills; manual picks a target season and intensity. Runs on bitcube alone, with no internet. Control page on port 9981.
inputs: river library (recorded clip at three speeds, on bitcube's disk)

modal.title: Combined with Modal Input Selector
modal.description: Will's Combined v0 (live river, summer look, framing, screen-look cycle) with one Modal input chosen in mission control: off; Dave's canvas added on top (today's look); Dave's scene recolouring the river with its palette and steering speed, density, brightness and turbulence; or Modal Frames, Dave's own pictures for each screen and the ropes, journeyed to in OKLCH and rippled by the live river. One strength slider; switching fades over 4 s without a restart. Stale Modal data fades back to plain Combined.
inputs: Dave's Modal canvas, mirrored scene and reflexes

shows.title: The live river
shows.label: the live river
shows.description: The river as it is right now: the river camera streams over Starlink and fills the ropes and screens, with a time-slice memory and sparkle on moving water. Dave's AI agent on Modal watches the room and the river, and every few minutes sets the palette, flow, rain and gain; his canvas plays as a faint layer. If the river feed drops it falls back to rain. Needs the internet, the river site and Modal.
